content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am trying to figure out how to use the function keys on the [product_name] operator device to control inputs. Specifically, I want to configure the F1 key so that pressing it momentarily activates input I2 to start a sequence. I read that at least one line of text is required for this configuration, but I mainly understand Ladder logic. My goal is simple: press F1 and start the process. Kind regards, [user_name].
It is not possible to directly control physical (digital) inputs with the function keys. The F keys cannot switch physical inputs; they can only operate in parallel to those inputs.

I may not have explained my intention clearly. What I actually want is to toggle output Q1 using the F1 key as the trigger. There is a holding contact M1 to keep Q1 closed further along in the program, and I do not have a physical switch available. My plan was to use the F1 key instead of input I2. Thank you for your patience.
Try using a pulse relay for this purpose.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to use function keys on their [product_name] operator device to control digital inputs/outputs within their system. They encountered an issue: function keys cannot directly activate physical digital inputs but can only be used in parallel to those. There is some confusion about the distinction between triggering outputs and physical inputs, particularly around configuring function keys with ladder logic.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to use the F1 function key on their [product_name] operator device as a substitute for a physical input or switch, aiming to easily initiate a program sequence just by pressing the F1 key.
